fns.desc: wpas_ctrl_iface_configure_scs: within the 'while (pos1)' multi-descriptor SCS parsing loop, three error paths (lines 12120, 12127, 12135 - 'SCSID already active'/'not active' checks) use bare 'return -1;' instead of 'goto free_scs_desc;'. If an earlier SCS descriptor in the same command was already successfully realloc'd into scs_data->scs_desc_elems (and its nested tclas_elems/filter_value/filter_mask), hitting one of these three checks on a later descriptor leaks scs_data->scs_desc_elems and everything referenced by it, since free_up_scs_desc(scs_data) is only called via the free_scs_desc: label.
